- [FACT] User asked how to get to Speyer from Frankfurt.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided several options for traveling from Frankfurt to Speyer:
  - By car: Approximately 1 hour and 10 minutes drive via A67 and A61 highways.
  - By train: Train journey from Frankfurt am Main Hauptbahnhof to Speyer Hauptbahnhof takes around 1 hour and 20 minutes with several direct and indirect trains available.
  - By bus: Bus journey takes around 1 hour and 30 minutes with several bus companies operating between the two cities.
  - By taxi: Taxi journey takes around 1 hour and can be quite expensive.
